title: Five goals and a fourth FA Cup.
body: Albion’s 1953/54 side came close to a league and cup double. They finished second in the First Division and ended the season with the FA Cup after a 3–2 victory over Preston North End.

The Wembley win belonged to a side built around players such as Ronnie Allen, Ray Barlow and captain Len Millard. It was the fourth FA Cup in Albion’s history. Read the club historian’s retrospective for the injuries, selection difficulties and attacking football behind that short line in the honours list.
